paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene: A fictional reader recognises two editors each expecting the other to send a newsletter, without knowing what each heard. Readiness signals, the next actor and confirmation of completion need clarity. This requires nobody to carry every reminder or prove reliability because of a quiz result.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡：“谁曾同意哪一步，什么表示已就绪，哪些安排仍需双方自愿确认？”可以只读或讨论虚构人物，不需寻找谁犯错、公开自己的计数或请真人解释。不同理解可保留，讨论不以贴标签或让计数降低为目标。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card asks: “Who agreed to which step, what signals readiness, and which arrangements still need voluntary confirmation?” Read alone or discuss fictional people without finding fault, publishing counts or requesting an actual person’s explanation. Different interpretations may remain; labels and lower counts are never goals.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与讨论卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，原练习可跳过。按当前能认出的无害例子选择，不增加回忆期限；熟悉感可以来自故事、观察或想象，不认证事件曾发生在自己身上。十二题各提供四个例子，共六个编辑主题；每主题仅出现八次、各答位两次，没出现在某题不算被拒绝。按明确映射为所选主题记一次，不按固定答位推断主题，不加权或反向。全部十二项有效才显示任何个人计数，无计分NA，缺答不补零、另一主题或提前派结果；都不合适可停止直接读六份全文。六项次数合十二，每项分母八为选项曝光，不是失误机会、发生率或严重度。最高值全部保留，例如全选第一项六类各二次，六份均展示；显示顺序不选赢家、不排主副型。受本题本选项限制，并非所有想象计数组合或并列集合都可达，不勉强生成缺少的结果。相差一次没有已验证的人群意义，同数不证明同样经历、原因或品质，较低值也不认证无失误。六主题描述选中例子的可见结果，现实可以重叠，不是通用科学分类；框架无已建立信效度、常模、预测或中英等值，不评智商、记忆、教育、注意、临床状况、道德和人的价值。虚构讨论无需真实文件、消息、地址、个人经历、联系或实际纠错；无人需要披露、受评或承担额外检查。页面内存、自选24小时标签页草稿及完成、退出、重测清除保持不变，复制只有公开匹配名称和链接，不含答案或次数，公开页不恢复私人答卷。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these additions. Reading alone suffices; existing exercises are optional. Choose harmless examples you currently recognise without adding a recall period. Familiarity may come from stories, observation or imagination and confirms no personal incident. Twelve questions each offer four examples across six editorial themes. Each theme appears only eight times, twice per position; absence from a question is no rejection. Add one to the selected theme through the stated mapping, not a fixed answer position, without weights or reversals. All twelve choices must be valid before any personal count. There is no scored NA and missingness supplies no zero, alternative theme or early result. If none fits, stop and read all six full guides. Six counts sum to twelve. A denominator of eight is option exposure, not error opportunities, frequency or severity. Keep every maximum: all first-position choices give two each and all six guides. Display order selects no winner or primary and secondary type. The offered options constrain reachable count vectors and tied sets; unavailable outcomes are not fabricated. One extra choice has no established population meaning; equal counts prove no equal experiences, causes or qualities, and lower values certify no absence of error. Themes describe visible outcomes in selected examples, can overlap in real life and are no universal scientific taxonomy. The framework has no established reliability, validity, norms, prediction or English–Chinese equivalence and assesses no IQ, memory, education, attention, clinical condition, morality or worth. Fictional discussion needs no real files, messages, addresses, personal history, contact or corrective action. Nobody owes disclosure, evaluation or extra checking. Page memory, optional 24-hour tab drafts and completion, exit or retake clearing remain unchanged. Copying contains only public matched titles and a link without answers or counts; public pages restore no private attempt.
